subject: wo-exp-pri
title: WO.EXP.PRI.------PROG.CONT.
description: Diagram in T(AF)M-40, paired with v1-p136-1. (C)WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) is crossed with PROG-CONT (progressional continuance): the question is what world-expansion (the basic principle by which a culture extends its reach) means when crossed with the progressional continuance of black creativity, given that AFI(1) — the transformation principle introduced on this very page — has just been named. WO-EXP-PRI outputs to PROG-CONT (the crossing partner) → CULT-SOLD (culture solidification), and to TR-INFO (trans-information), MT-INFO (music information). TR-INFO branches to ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism) and SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). MT-INFO branches to TRS (transition) and ATTN (attraction). TRS solid-links to AFL (affinity alignment) and PART (participation). The structural claim: world-expansion crossed with progressional continuance requires *both* trans-information producing alternative composite progressionalism *and* music information producing transition into participation — with spiritual dynamics as a side-branch from trans-information. Read against AFI(1)'s introduction: this is the diagrammatic specification of what *transformation-grade* world expansion would have to operate through — exactly the spiritual-dynamics-grounded alternative composite progressionalism that AFI(1) demands.
